findings.detail: Option A refers to 'the renamed tool', but no rename has been stated at that point. The rename appears only later, in option B. A reader of A cannot tell which tool is meant on a first reading, and A depends on another option to make sense. Option A should name the tool, for example 'Rewrite the description of analyze_content…' or 'of extract_web_results…'.
The feature "tool description" is not in the exam guide.

blind_answer.reason: Per 2.1-S2, the fix for overlap is to rename analyze_content to extract_web_results (B) and rewrite its description to state that it takes web search input and to explain when analyze_document is the better choice (A). Merging the tools (C) removes the specialization. A keyword-based routing rule in the system prompt (D) creates unintended tool associations. Shortening the descriptions to one line (E) makes tool selection less reliable.
